title: Penny wanted a chef and got a menu

beats.say: Penny asks Bolt for a business process. A quick one to do her work.
beats.speaker: penny

beats.say: Bolt announces: building business process. It hands her a shorter menu.
beats.speaker: bolt

beats.say: Just the Stage values her team sees.
It automates nothing, and arrives through a record type.
Penny wanted a chef. She got a menu.

facts.claim: A business process automates nothing; it only constrains which lifecycle picklist values are offered.
facts.evidence: a business process automates nothing, it only constrains which lifecycle values are offered

facts.claim: Sales processes filter the opportunity Stage picklist.
facts.evidence: sales processes filter the opportunity Stage picklist

facts.claim: Each business process is assigned to a record type, which is how users get it.
facts.evidence: each one is assigned to a record type
